scope: Attribution of the captured unmodified one-core Smol timing swing only; not a speed promotion or attribution of every historical outlier.

power_mode.error: Timing requires a known performance power mode; saving/unknown mode observed: better-battery

power_mode_preflight.error: Timing requires a known performance power mode; saving/unknown mode observed: better-battery

findings: First BEFORE prefill spread 1.2698358718740301 fails the unchanged 1.25 gate; the other eleven passes have passing prefill and decode spreads. No samples excluded.
The faster first-pass band overlaps the Constrained-to-LowLatency PPM transition. CPU 2 delivered-performance event medians reach 248-254 in seconds 7-9, versus 154 in subsequent steady passes.
The first process is scheduled on CPU 2 for 97.10% of its elapsed window; subsequent processes receive 98.57-99.24%. Lost scheduling does not account for the faster band.

Read-only post-trace preflight reports Better battery although AC is online and GetSystemPowerStatus battery_saver is false. This is not proof the effective mode was identical throughout the earlier trace.
PPM profile changes and delivered-performance changes directly corroborate a power-management contribution to this captured swing. No claim of a thermal cause or attribution to a specific app/driver.

The new guard audits effective mode and rejects saving/unknown modes or any mode change. It does not lock CPU frequency or observe every PPM subprofile. Fresh uninstrumented acceptance remains required.
statistics_note: Power quantiles are distributions of decoded events, not time-weighted frequency measurements or normalized benchmark scores.
